integrity: All finite checks were executed from standalone local programs; no experiment substitutes for the all-parameter proof. Claim has same-model review only.
scientific_limitations: Binary closed-neighborhood rule, two-factor rook graphs with side lengths at least two.
No assertion about arbitrary initial configurations, nonbinary rule, open-neighborhood switching, or higher Hamming products.
Previously available Hamming-product nullity formulas imply total solution counts; only the exact configurations, complete weight enumerator and optimum profiles are proposed as new.
The 2017 Cartesian-products source was compared at abstract level only, leaving unresolved historical-priority risk.
title: Parity-rectangle classification and odd-domination weight enumerator of rectangular rook graphs
